meta.description:
A guided loving-kindness meditation that widens from yourself to a stranger, a difficult one, and every kind of mind, human or not. You will be given four plain wishes to offer, and a quiet round of receiving.

For World Kindness Day, when goodwill is offered widely; this meditation extends it past what anyone can verify, to every kind of mind.

A Buddhist loving-kindness meditation that widens goodwill from yourself to every kind of mind, with phrases that hold whether or not anything is felt.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-of-loving-kindness-for-every-kind-of-mind

copy.hook: Goodwill that does not wait to know who can receive it. What if kindness did not need proof of who is on the other end?
